create_ShTest: create a ShTest instance to run LLVM regression tests with shell-like command pipelines and output assertions
test_ShTest_execute: test the ShTest execute method that delegates to lit.TestRunner.executeShTest with test, litConfig, and execute_external flag
review_ShTest_init: review the ShTest __init__ method that sets execute_external flag for controlling external command execution
build_lit_test_format: build a lit test format class inheriting from FileBasedTest for one-file-per-test regression testing
run_executeShTest: run lit.TestRunner.executeShTest to execute shell-based test files with assertions on expected output
